swap_risks: CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS54202DDCR: 15 µH p.17 vs TPS54302DDCR: 10 µH p.18); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS54202DDCR specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS54302DDCR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
engineering_verdict: TPS54202DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because recommended inductor value differs >20%; current rating or switch-limit basis differs. Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 500 kHz (p.5) vs 400 kHz (p.5) (1.3x ratio), typical inductor 15 µH (p.17) vs 10 µH (p.18), feedback Vref 0.596 V (p.5) vs 0.596 V (p.5), and package θJA 118.6 vs 118.9 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS54202DDCR "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN" (p.4) and TPS54302DDCR "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose TPS54202DDCR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-6 (DDC) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TPS54302DDCR when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
